notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to give Vrondiss indestructible.
description:
Give Vrondiss indestructible, if needed.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Vrondiss.
Vrondiss' first ability triggers, causing you to create a 5/4 Dragon Spirit creature token.
When the Dragon Spirit enters the battlefield, Halana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Dragon Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Halana trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal 1 damage to Vrondiss.
Repeat from step 4.
